candidate_title: Assisted Declarative Process Creation from Natural Language Descriptions

review_output.decision_rationale: The title and abstract explicitly describe using NLP on natural language descriptions/text documents to support creation of declarative process models/DCR graphs. This matches NLP for process extraction/construction from natural-language text at Stage 1.
